tung.name: Tung Tung Tung Sahur
tung.description: A scary anomaly that only comes out at Sahur
tung.bio: The phrase "Tung Tung Tung" mimics the sound of a traditional bedug drum used during Sahur. If someone fails to respond to the call three times, he will appear to remind the person. Don't mess with him.
tung.abilities: He is extremely fast and will suddenly appear when you least expect him. He will hit you with his giant stick.
tung.trivia: Although associated with Italian brainrot, he actually came from Indonesia.

tralalero.name: Tralalero Tralala
tralalero.description: A flamboyant and cunning trickster known for his playful yet mischievous nature.
tralalero.bio: Tralalero Tralala is an infamous figure in the Italian underground scene, renowned for his sharp wit and unpredictable tactics. Skilled in deception and evasion, he thrives on chaos and loves turning the tables on his enemies.
tralalero.abilities: Master of disguise and illusion, capable of creating distractions that confuse opponents. Agile and quick, able to dodge attacks effortlessly.
tralalero.trivia: Despite his mischievous nature, Tralala has a soft spot for music and often hums old Italian tunes to calm himself.

bombardiro.name: Bombardiro Crocodilo
bombardiro.description: A fierce and relentless warrior with a tough exterior and a strategic mind.
bombardiro.bio: Bombardiro Crocodilo earned his name through his aggressive combat style and armored resilience reminiscent of a crocodile. He is a tactical genius who leads charges into battle with unyielding determination and protects his allies fiercely.
bombardiro.abilities: Possesses incredible strength and endurance, able to withstand heavy blows. As he can fly, he has an immediate advantage against land-based enemies. Skilled in heavy weaponry and battlefield tactics, he can drop several types of ordnance and conduct air reconnaisance.
bombardiro.trivia: His favorite pastime outside of battle is crafting detailed miniature models of ancient warships.

cappuccino.name: Cappuccino Assassino
cappuccino.description: A stealthy and precise assassin, known for striking quickly and disappearing without a trace.
cappuccino.bio: Cappuccino Assassino is a master of silent movement and deadly accuracy. Trained in covert operations, he blends charm with lethal efficiency, making him both a feared adversary and a valuable ally. He is married to Ballerina Cappuccina.
cappuccino.abilities: Expert in close-quarters combat and knife throwing. Exceptional at infiltration and gathering intelligence unnoticed.
cappuccino.trivia: He enjoys the quiet moments before dawn with a strong espresso, believing it sharpens his senses.

lirili.name: Lirili Larila
lirili.description: A whimsical yet chaotic spirit who sings ancient rhymes to bend reality.
lirili.bio: No one knows where she came from. She skips through alleyways leaving trails of glitter, brainrot, and fragmented song lyrics. Her voice can crack concrete — and minds.
lirili.abilities: Reality distortion through chaotic lullabies. Can hypnotize or overload targets with nonsense.
lirili.trivia: Her favorite word is 'snigglepop' and she doesn’t know what it means either.

bombombini.name: Bombombini Gusini
bombombini.enemies: Anyone who tells him to calm down
bombombini.description: An explosive agent of chaos with a short fuse and too much energy.
bombombini.bio: Bombombini runs on pure sugar, explosives, and caffeine. Known for demolishing buildings for fun. He communicates in high-pitched screeches and cryptic memes.
bombombini.abilities: Can throw timed bombs with absurd precision. Immune to explosions. Moves unpredictably like a pinball.
bombombini.trivia: Thinks the moon is alive and owes him money.

ballerina.name: Ballerina Cappuccina
ballerina.description: A graceful dancer with deadly precision and a calm killer instinct.
ballerina.bio: Ballerina Cappuccina blends ballet with brutality. Married to Cappuccino Assassino, she waltzes through battlefields in perfect form — every pirouette a death sentence.
ballerina.abilities: Deadly footwork, razor-sharp toe-blades, and soundless movement. Can kill in silence and vanish in rhythm.
ballerina.trivia: Choreographs every fight beforehand in her head.

boneca.name: Boneca Ambalabu
boneca.description: A frog-like plastic entity fused to a spinning wheel. Her legs move. She does not stop.
boneca.bio: Boneca Ambalabu was discovered deep within a bin of rejected carnival toys. She is a green plastic frog with two motorized legs, permanently attached to a cheap red wheel. When activated, she spins in erratic circles, chanting her name like a cursed samba summoning.
boneca.abilities: Unpredictable spin-dash. Screeches 'AMBALABU' in 144p mono audio. Causes nearby objects to fall over from sheer vibes.
boneca.trivia: Her movement pattern is studied by physicists and priests alike. Once activated, no one knows how to turn her off.
